equipment: no reset button on this board
environment: RC receiver part of the unpowered VTX, so no RC link

observations: Three cold boots (USB unplugged between runs) reached the same steady state: PLL48 valid at 48 MHz, SPI2 flash ef:40:18 16 MiB supported, ICM42688-P WHO_AM_I 71, flash recovered at page 15784 with config seq 21, telemetry-qualified DShot arming on PA10.
Every DShot report in all three runs was [0, 0, 0, 0] with faults 0; no arming and no panic occurred.
The two-second SPI2 heartbeat continued to the end of each capture, the longest about 50 seconds.
One boot-time `IMU stale in control loop: seq 0, stale ticks 1` per run, before the first IMU sample.
ESC telemetry latched faulted after M1's response timeout in each run, correct with no ESC power.
Operator observed the board's LEDs lit and nothing else abnormal; no heat or unexpected behaviour.
No `UART4 RX free-buffer pool exhausted on IDLE` in any of the three runs; the earlier sighting remains deferred to the powered gate, where the VTX drives that line.
Probe-side errors ending runs 1 and 2 (device disconnected, SwdDpError) are the SWD session dropping on USB unplug, not firmware behaviour.
First run under the candidate whose task bodies are ferroforge::app! instances of ferrowasp-stm32f4-tasks definitions.
limitations: No oscilloscope or logic analyzer available: the check that no motor output pulses occur before the actuator-output task is initialized was not observed electrically. Actuator power was disconnected throughout, so no pulse could reach a motor; direct observation is deferred to the powered props-off gate.
Motor outputs at stop are evidenced by the firmware's own DShot reports, not by measurement at the pins.
This board has no reset button, so reset was exercised as a cold USB power cycle; no brownout was induced and NRST was not asserted.
The procedure's red/green LED heartbeat check does not apply to this board: its manifest sets onboard_debug_leds_usable_with_swd to false. The RTT heartbeat was used instead.
The RC receiver is powered from the battery through the VTX, so 'disarmed with the receiver disconnected' was established with no RC hardware powered at all.
